label: Data Fundamentals
description: Learn the foundational data types—discrete, continuous, and categorical—that underpin all data visualization and business insight.

label: Basic Principles
description: Master the core visual elements of effective charts: height comparisons, proper labeling, units, and clear value representation.

label: Chart Types
description: Explore standard visualization types including bar, line, pie, and gauge charts. Experiment with how category count impacts clarity.

label: Parts and wholes
description: Understand how to show what makes up a whole using pie charts, stacked bars, and area charts. Learn when to use each approach.

label: Distributions
description: See how values spread across a range and how often they occur. Master histograms and distribution patterns in your data.

label: Events and Time Series
description: Visualize how data changes over time. Learn techniques for showing events, trends, and patterns in time-series data.
